title: Tesserae component fragment
description: A Tesserae component fragment: `*_Component.yaml`. One node, with `params:` naming the `{{ }}` it fills in.

parameter.description: A fragment parameter: filled in where the fragment is used.

conditional.description: A value chosen by a parameter: `{if: "{{ flag }}", then: a, else: b}`.

color.description: A theme role (such as `surface` or `on_primary`), `#RGB`, `#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`, `transparent`, a CSS colour name, or a CSS function such as `rgb(...)` or `oklch(...)`.

style.description: How a node looks and lays out its children.

align_content.description: How wrapped rows, or grid tracks, are spaced.

align_items.description: Where its children sit across the layout axis.

align_self.description: Overrides its parent's `align_items` for this node.

aspect_ratio.description: Width over height: gives the missing side from the one set.

background.description: Its fill: a theme role such as `surface`, `#RRGGBB`, or any CSS colour.

border_width.description: The width of its border, in pixels.

clip_children.description: Whether children are cut off at its edge.

corner_radius.description: Pixels, or a shape token (`none` to `extra_large`).

flex_basis.description: Its size along the main axis before it grows or shrinks.

flex_direction.description: How its children are laid out: `horizontal` (the default) or `vertical`.

flex_grow.description: How much of the spare room it takes, relative to its siblings.

flex_shrink.description: How much it gives up when there is too little room.

flex_wrap.description: `wrap` lets children flow onto more lines; `no_wrap` keeps one.

foreground.description: Its text or glyph colour: a theme role, `#RRGGBB`, or any CSS colour.

grid_auto_columns.description: The size of columns the template doesn't name.

grid_auto_flow.description: How grid children fill the cells.

grid_auto_rows.description: The size of rows the template doesn't name.

grid_column.description: Which grid column it takes: `2`, or `1 / 3`.

grid_row.description: Which grid row it takes: `2`, or `1 / 3`.

grid_template_columns.description: The grid's columns, as in CSS: `1fr 2fr 100px`.

grid_template_rows.description: The grid's rows, as in CSS.

height.description: Pixels, `auto` (its content's size, or stretched), or a percentage of the parent such as `50%`.

justify_content.description: Where its children sit along the layout axis.

justify_items.description: Where grid children sit across their cell's width.

justify_self.description: Where this node sits across its grid cell's width.

margin.description: Space outside it: one number, or `{left, right, top, bottom}`.

max_height.description: The most height it can take.

max_width.description: The most width it can take.

min_height.description: The least height it can take.

min_width.description: The least width it can take.

padding.description: Space inside it: one number, or `{left, right, top, bottom}`.

position.description: `absolute` takes it out of the flow and places it at `x` and `y`.

width.description: Pixels, `auto` (its content's size, or stretched), or a percentage of the parent such as `50%`.

x.description: Where an `absolute` node sits from the left.

y.description: Where an `absolute` node sits from the top.

z_index.description: Stacking order: higher is in front.

text.description: What a Text, Link or TextField says, and in what type.

anyOf.description: A Material 3 type style: it sets the font, size, weight and line height.
Where the text sits in its node's width. Not for a TextField.

handlers.description: What a user's action calls: the name of a ViewModel method, or `window.<action>`.

on_click.description: Runs on `click`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

on_hover_enter.description: Runs on `pointer_enter`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

on_hover_exit.description: Runs on `pointer_leave`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

on_change.description: Runs on `change`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

on_focus_enter.description: Runs on `focus`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

on_focus_exit.description: Runs on `unfocus`: a ViewModel method name, or one of `window.minimize`, `window.maximize`, `window.restore`, `window.toggle_maximized`, `window.close`.

a11y.description: What assistive technology is told about this node.

label.description: The name a screen reader says.

role.description: What kind of thing it is.

live.description: How changes to it are announced.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

classes.description: Style classes a theme or stylesheet rule can match.

min.description: The least a Slider or SpinBox takes.

max.description: The most a Slider or SpinBox takes.

step.description: How far a Slider or SpinBox moves.

src.description: An image file, relative to this one.

fit.description: How it fills its box: `cover` (the default), `contain`, ...

anyOf.description: Properties kept live from the ViewModel: `{{ expression }}`.

two_way.description: The one bound property whose user edits write back to the ViewModel.

anyOf.description: A Rect or Container's hover, press and focus feedback: `true`, `false`, or `{color: ...}`.

group.description: A RadioButton's group: the ones with one name exclude each other.

component_of.description: The fragment this node is the root of.

disabled.description: Whether the node ignores input and fades.

window_region.description: `drag`: a press here moves the window (a title bar); `none`: it does not.

params.description: The parameters this fragment takes: each `{{ name }}` is filled from `with:`. A name is required; `{name: default}` is optional.

when.description: Keeps this child only when the value is true.

id.description: A name for this node, unique in the view. Handlers, bindings and `view.node(id)` use it.

icon.description: An icon name, shown before the title.

buttons.description: Which window buttons, in order: minimize, maximize, close (all by default).

classes.description: Style classes a theme or stylesheet rule can match.

title_bar.description: A window title bar: an icon, a title, your own content and the window's buttons. Needs `App(decorations=False)`.

repeat.description: One call per entry, each merged over `with:`.

component_call.description: A fragment used in place: `component: Name` and its `with:` parameters.
